_comment: External MCP servers for Weebot. Loaded when WEEBOT_ENABLE_X_MCP=1 and MCP_SERVERS_CONFIG_PATH points here. Dollar-brace variable references come from .env; an unset one skips only the server that uses it (a warning is logged), and that includes any written inside these comments. Tools arrive as mcp__<server>__<tool>: their output is untrusted, and publish/send/delete/generate tools always ask (WEEBOT_OUTBOUND_TOOL_PATTERNS).

postiz._comment: Self-hosted Postiz (~/postiz/compose, docker compose). API key: Postiz UI > Settings > Public API.

jira._comment: Jira Cloud via the community mcp-atlassian server (uvx). Token: id.atlassian.com > Security > API tokens.

hubspot._comment: HubSpot CRM via HubSpot's own MCP server (npx). Token: HubSpot Settings > Integrations > Private Apps.

apify._comment: Apify's hosted MCP server: search the Apify Store and run any Actor (billed to the Apify account). Token: console.apify.com > Settings > API & Integrations. The same key turns on the built-in apify_* preset tools.

agent_desktop._comment: vercel-labs/agent-desktop (npm i -g agent-desktop, or cargo): see and operate desktop apps through the OS accessibility tree. No trust key, so the server is untrusted: every desktop_* tool asks before it runs, and its snapshots are fenced as untrusted content (they can carry private screen text). Tools arrive as mcp__agent_desktop__desktop_<command>.

awwwards._comment: INSANE0777/Awwwards-mcp (MIT, no API key): search award-winning sites, extract motion and stack, design briefs, build checks. Pinned; `core` profile = 13 tools. Browser tools (capture_live_site, verify_build) need Playwright and Chromium installed. No trust key, so the server is untrusted: every tool asks before it runs and its output is fenced as untrusted content. Personal, non-commercial inspiration use per its README. Tools arrive as mcp__awwwards__<tool>.
